/bin/bash -lc "perl -0pi -e \"s/const renderPreview = React\\.useCallback<RenderPreview>\\(\\s*\\(\\{getValue, md\\}\\) => <MarkdownPreview getValue=\\{getValue\\} md=\\{md\\} \\/>,\\s*\\[\\],\\s*\\);/const renderPreview = React.useCallback<RenderPreview>(\\n    ({getValue, md}) => <MarkdownPreview getValue={getValue} md={md} />,\\n    [],\\n  );/s\" src/App.tsx
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p = Path('src/App.tsx')
s = p.read_text()
s = s.replace('    allowHTML: false,\\n', '')
s = s.replace('    initial: undefined,\\n', '')
s = s.replace('    markup: initialMarkdown,\\n', '    md: {html: false},\\n    initial: {markup: initialMarkdown},\\n')
p.write_text(s)
PY
npm run build"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -i '/    allowHTML: false,/d' src/App.tsx
sed -i 's/    markup: initialMarkdown,/    md: {html: false},\\n    initial: {markup: initialMarkdown},/' src/App.tsx
sed -i 's/({getValue, md}) => <MarkdownPreview getValue={getValue} md={md} \\/>/({getValue, md}) => <MarkdownPreview getValue={getValue} md={md} \\/>/' src/App.tsx
npm run build"
